notes.title: Update 1.2 - Born Anew
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Survivors! [/p][p]We’ve been hard at work these past few weeks, combing through your feedback and chasing down the most reported issues. Update 1.2 is a smaller patch, but it brings something for everyone: a new endgame feature, a golden new structure, and plenty of fixes and quality-of-life tweaks. [/p][p][/p][h2]✨ [b]New Endgame Feature: Rebirth[/b][/h2][p]For those of you who already maxed out the Favour tree, there is now a new challenge. You can sacrifice all that progress in exchange for an [b]extra Power slot[/b], opening up new build possibilities and pushing your late-game runs even further. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/aaf8d8643cb3a3147ad821cb0662e501d2d21b54.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🏛️ [b]New Structure: Midas Statue[/b][/h2][p]What’s better than gold? More gold!
That’s why our new structure, [b]Midas Statue,[/b] can transform enemies into gold… and make them drop Gold when slain. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/db74512912f9332e8672a31e2d742a5025ba1533.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ [b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2][p]You asked for more clarity and smoother play, so here’s what we added:[/p][list][*][p]Kamikaze enemies now play a [b]distinct sound effect[/b]. They are [b]easier to notice[/b] and a bit more fun to dodge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold time[/b] [b]shortened [/b]when using reroll, so you [b]get back to action sooner[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new on-screen[b] tips[/b] to help explain options and mechanics, so [b]new and returning players learn faster[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]leave the Workshop with ESC[/b], which makes [b]navigating menus quicker[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]⚖️ [b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Dodge cap introduced:[/b] Player Dodge has been capped to [b]preserve challenge[/b]. Say goodbye to your immortal builds…[b] [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Shield Throw buffed: Higher damage and longer duration make the Power more comparable with the rest.[/p][/*][*][p]Scaling adjusted for Locus of Repulsion so it remains useful without overwhelming other tools at high levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Status Strength improvements are now available for Pronomus’ Power from the start.[/p][/*][*][p]Blades of Madness upgraded: Starts with 3 blades (up from 2), with higher damage and a slightly longer duration for stronger crowd control.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Wrath of Ares cooldown so the Power feels more dynamic during fights.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p]And of course, plenty of fixes to make your runs smoother:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Workshop no longer breaks after very long sessions.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Enemies killed by Myrmidons spawned from the Trojan Horse now properly count toward the “enemies killed by buildings” objective on Greece Map 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where some attacks collided with incorrect objects in The Chambers of Bridges.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected French localization for clearer UI and descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the Rift circle objective element. This now matches how event-spawned Rifts behave, improving consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed uneven ground on one location that could cause movement issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected Medusa Statue category color to Support, matching its true category.[/p][/*][*][p]On ultrawide monitors, the event countdown seconds no longer overlap the minimap.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]One last note for our console players:[/b] [/h3][p]the PlayStation and Xbox updates are almost done cooking. Once testing and store certification are complete, those versions will jump straight to 1.2, bringing all the content from Updates 1.1 and 1.2 in one go. We are also wrapping up work on the Nintendo Switch, which will launch directly with 1.2 so everyone starts on equal footing.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]💬 How are you all doing?[/b] [/h2][p]Beside working on updates, we’ve been sneaking in some time with [i]Silksong[/i] ːsilksongː. Team Cherry did it again, "just one more try on this boss... One more, I promise..."[/p][p][i]\[Cut to a clock showing 4 AM][/i][/p][p]ːshermaː[/p][p]Thank you for being here with us. We can’t wait to see you all on the battlefield, no matter where you play. It’s getting very autumn-y here in Poland, but of course your support keeps us warm. 💙[/p][p]~Dark Point Games Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/e2230d8fa801ec1db79c142fc5b45e16d35083fa.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - The Gift of Midas
notes.content:
[p]Survivors - [/p][p]we didn’t want you waiting long.[/p][p]It’s been just over two weeks since the full release of [i]Achilles: Survivor[/i], and you’ve already filled our Discord, reviews, and inboxes with feedback. Some of it was praise (thank you 💙), some was bug reports (thank you, too!), and plenty was “can you please fix this now?”[/p][p]The answer is “yes, of course, we will try our best!”[/p][p]So we rolled up our sleeves, grabbed a pot of molten gold from King Midas’ vault, and forged Update 1.1 as quickly as we could. Almost every change you’ll read here comes directly from your comments and ideas.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]✨ New Power: Tears of Midas[/b][/h2][p][i]Fire golden projectiles from both sides of your Survivor, slicing through enemies with style worthy of a king’s treasury. [/i][/p][p]King Midas was said to turn everything he touched into gold - an extraordinary gift that became his curse. In [i]Achilles: Survivor[/i], his tears fell heavy, each drop carrying the weight of his regret, and the power to destroy what they touched. Those tears take form of bright, golden projectiles from both sides of your Survivor, cutting through enemy ranks. [/p][p]Their radiant arcs make them perfect for sweeping aside entire groups and keeping the battlefield clear on every flank. This power is available for all Survivors.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/8503b9659cd61c38de39126b4738eb009a7776d8.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]🌍 New Language: Portuguese[/b][/h2][p]Now fully supported in menus, UI, and gameplay - welcome to the battlefield, Survivors from Portugal and Brazil![/p][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2][p][i]Our first priority was to address the most frustrating, game-breaking moments - like getting stuck in buildings or dealing with those kamikaze enemies you’ve told us so much about.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added a [b]Pause Menu “Unstuck” button[/b] so you can instantly free yourself if you get trapped by buildings or terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Made [b]Kamikaze enemies[/b] easier to spot and reduced their damage so they’re still dangerous, but no longer punishingly unfair.[/p][/*][*][p]Gave mid-bosses a small chance to drop the [b]Magnetic Harp[/b], making those fights more rewarding.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]progress bar for timed events[/b] so you know exactly when the next one will start, plus a toggle in settings if you prefer a cleaner screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Made event and stone deposit icons on the minimap [b]flash briefly[/b] when they appear so you can react faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]“How to Play” reminder popup[/b] before your first run so new players know where to find tips - shown only once, so it won’t annoy you.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]controller vibration[/b] when you take damage so hits feel more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Basement and Rift [/b] circles caused too much confusion, so we replaced [b]them [/b]with timers so you instantly understand how those mechanics work. [/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]E and Q keyboard shortcuts[/b] to scroll tabs left and right, so you can navigate menus faster without touching the mouse.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ UI Improvements[/b][/h2][p][i]Many of you told us the UI made it harder to play than it should be, so we’ve cleaned it up and made key information easier to find at a glance.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Added a visual marker to Favours that are ready to be claimed, so you’ll instantly know when a new one is available.[/p][/*][*][p]Reordered [b]pause/summary screen stats[/b] so the most important info is easier to find.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to let you [b]check your current Powers[/b] directly from the improvement or transformation selection screens, helping you make better upgrade choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of [b]Power tags[/b] ([i]Range[/i], [i]Strike[/i], etc.) so you can compare abilities more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Added clear [b]seconds indicators[/b] to Structure Invulnerability so you know exactly how long the effect lasts.[/p][/*][*][p]Revealed the [b]titles of locked Survivors[/b] so achievements make more sense and both Achilles variants are easier to tell apart.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved [b]event start popups[/b] to match boss warning placement so they’re more noticeable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Objective tuning[/b]: Lowered requirements for some of the most demanding objectives so they still require effort, but less luck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge[/b]: Increased durability so it will last you longer in battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Statue of Medusa output[/b]: Increased cooldown, with further increases for each additional Statue built, to keep resource gains balanced over time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Agamemnon’s Wrath[/b]: Reduced cooldown from 15s to 11s so you can use it more often.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🐛 [b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Myrmidons[/b] could get stuck and stop fighting. They now work as intended and will support you in battle instead of slacking off.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision in the [b]Medusa Statue [/b]that could trap players.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected names and icons for several Steam achievements ([i]Conquest of Endless Troy[/i], [i]Conquest of Endless Dungeons[/i], [i]Conquest of Endless Mountain Fortress[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect [b]first-level value[/b] for the Enchanter’s “Greed of Enchanter” Favour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Magical Overload[/b] for Enchanter so it properly increases your cooldown speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers above [b]2.1 billion[/b] now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed [b]Medusa building category[/b] from “Turret” to “Support” so it’s listed properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]language fixes[/b] in Polish, Chinese, and French.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]A Golden Thank You 💛[/b][/h2][p]Thank you for the incredible launch, for every comment, and for sticking with us through the bumps along the way. In just two weeks, you’ve helped shape [i]Achilles: Survivor[/i] more than we could have alone.[/p][p]With Update 1.1, we’re also introducing the [i]Supporter Pack[/i] - a small, purely cosmetic DLC forged in the spirit of King Midas. Just as his touch turned all it met into gold, this pack gives every Survivor a shimmering golden skin and places a unique supporter’s badge in your main menu.[/p][p]And the most important perk:[/p][p]Your support helps us keep updating Achilles: Survivor, move our next project forward, and bring new worlds from our little studio in Toruń to your screen ❤️[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3950710/Achilles_Survivor__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If that’s not your thing, that’s perfect too - your trust already means more than gold to us.[/p][p]Keep telling us what works, what frustrates you, and what you dream of seeing next. Every run you play helps us make the next one better.[/p][p]See you on the battlefield, Survivors!
[b]~ Dark Point Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix 1.0.2 Incoming [right now]
notes.content:
[p]Hello Survivors,[/p][p]We’ve just released a second hotfix to improve your experience after the 1.0 launch. Today’s changes focus on clarity, performance, and those elusive achievements:[/p][p]✅ [b]Determination VIII & IX - Fixed for 0.6 saves[/b][/p][p]If you’ve continued from an Early Access save, these two achievements should now track properly.[/p][p][b]✅ FPS limit[/b][/p][p]To help people that reported their GPUs overheating, we set the FPS limit to default.[/p][p]You can of course adjust it freely in settings![/p][p][b]✅ Ray Tracing Toggle[/b][/p][p]More graphic settings: Ray Tracing can now be turned on and off in the settings.[/p][p][b]✅ Clearer Side Objective Description[/b][/p][p]We’ve updated the confusing challenge text: [b]“Build a forge and transform any power”[/b] to [b]“Raise any power to level 5 and build the forge.”[/b]
Clearer. Hopefully less frustrating.[/p][p][b]✅ Spelling & Description Fixes[/b][/p][p]No more “Enchaters” in your menus - we’ve corrected a bunch of minor typos and weird phrasing across UI elements.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🔧 For those experiencing crashes[/b][/h3][p]We’re still actively working on a fix for the crash issue affecting some players, especially those using the latest NVIDIA drivers.[/p][p][b]If this is happening to you, we’d be incredibly grateful for your help:[/b] [/p][p]👉 Join our Discord [url="https://discord.com/invite/H7HEfABP9U"]https://discord.com/invite/H7HEfABP9U[/url] and ping or DM [b]Roni[/b] in this thread - [url="https://discord.com/channels/837643184527114260/1402252864914718773"]Discord - Group Chat That’s All Fun & Games[/url] - we’re gathering logs from affected players in a private crash channel. Every report helps us move faster.[/p][p]In the meantime, turning off Ray Tracing might be worth a try while we work on the proper fix.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]💬 Final Words[/b]
These fixes wouldn’t be possible without your feedback - thank you to everyone who left a review, message, or bug report this week.[/p][p][b]At the end, we want to give a special shoutout to one person in particular:[/b][/p][p]Huge thanks to [b]Exo[/b] from our Discord. From the very start, they reported the Determination achievement bug, kept us updated, and even shared their save file to help us test the fix.[/p][p]Your help made a real difference - thank you for being a part of our journey 💙[/p][p]
~Dark Point Games Team[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix 1.0.1 is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Survivors!
A bit of good news today - we’ve just released Hotfix 1.0.1 to tackle some of the biggest issues reported after launch. [/p][p][/p][p]Here's what it addresses:[/p][p]✅ [b]Save loss issue is (hopefully) fixed[/b]
With this update, your saves should now safely sync with Steam Cloud, even if the game closes unexpectedly.[/p][p]And remember - if this has happened to you, we are here for you! Come by our Discord and we’ll recover your save: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FH7HEfABP9U"]Steam Community[/url] .[/p][p][b]✅ No more getting stuck in buildings[/b][/p][p]You can no longer get trapped inside a structure if you're standing in its preview (ghost) form while it's being built.[/p][p]✅ [b]Determination VIII & IX achievements[/b]
These should now track progress correctly for everyone.[/p][p]✅ [b]Anti-aliasing option now works[/b]
Disabling anti-aliasing in the settings now correctly takes effect.[/p][p]✅ [b]Manual Aim label removed[/b]
We’ve removed the “not recommended” tag next to the Manual Aim setting - it’s working well enough now that we’re confident in letting you decide for yourself. (It’s cosmetic only, nothing about the system changed.)[/p][p][b]✅[/b] [b]Credits added[/b]
We’ve updated the in-game credits and want to sincerely apologize to our team members whose names were missing before 😅 Thank you for your work - and your patience.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]What’s next?[/h3][list][*][p][b]We’re actively working on a fix for the crash issues caused by the latest NVIDIA driver update.[/b] Thank you for your patience - we know how frustrating this is. In the meantime, you can find a temporary workaround here:
[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2922410/discussions/0/596281849306875891/?tscn=1754294841"]Steam Thread: Fatal Error after updating drivers[/url][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’re also gathering feedback on what you’d like us to focus on next. Balance changes? New content? More QoL improvements? [b]We want to hear what’s important to you![/b][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We hope this hotfix makes your experience smoother 😊 Let us know if the game works better for you now![/p][p]~Dark Point Games Team[/p]

notes.title: The Final Battle Begins - Full Release Update Is Here
notes.content:
[p]Survivors![/p][p][i]You thought you could escape my wrath. [/i][/p][p][i]You fought your way through scorched coastlines, blood-soaked battlefields, and cursed fortresses - each run a desperate step toward freedom. But every path, every escape, always led you back to where it all began -[/i][/p][p][i]- to me.[/i][/p][p]And now, there’s nowhere left to run.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/f5f3f748cb5b322859d4f4e9f6b9fe047a00c92b.png"][/img][/p][p]Descend into the Depths of Tartarus and face your greatest challenge yet. [/p][p]No more second chances. [/p][p]Will you let the gods define your fate… or make a last stand against the one who started it all?[/p][p][strike]We're in the Endgame now.[/strike][/p][h3][b]🎉 Achilles: Survivor leaves Early Access today.[/b][/h3][p][b]Version 1.0 brings more changes than all previous updates combined:[/b] you’ll face new horrors in a twisted realm, test your strength in Endless Mode, gain new powers, and unlock four powerful new Survivors - each with their own unique playstyle.[/p][p][b]Read on to discover what’s waiting for you in version 1.0.[/b] 
And maybe grab a jug of tea - or ambrosia - because it’s [i]a lot[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌍 New Realm:[/b] Dungeons. Explore the Depths of Tartarus.[/h2][p][i]Venture into the darkest corners of the underworld in our brand-new fourth realm. [/i][/p][p]Dungeons are no ordinary prison - the souls of condemned bandits and terrifying creatures roam among the ruined structures, allowing no Survivor to escape without a fight.[/p][p][b]You’ll face new, terrifying enemies, deadly midbosses, and powerful Overlords in six narrow, labyrinthine locations that leave little room to run… and nowhere to hide.[/b][/p][p]What lies in wait within the Depths of Tartarus?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/7ef9d634480417ebda04d47ddc1c8396195ae967.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]🛠️ New Feature:[/b] Endless Mode. Prepare for Endless Pain[/h2][p][i]Your adventure with Achilles can now last forever… Or at least as long as your skills allow. [/i][/p][p]Every realm now has its own Endless variant, perfect for pushing your build to its limits. [b]Survive as long as you can[/b] (and let us know your best time 💙)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/b287ffc64ce6ed9caa4fe6122121453dc81cfe21.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]🛠️ New Feature:[/b] Talents. Unlock a unique ability for each Survivor[/h2][p][i]Each Survivor has gained a unique Talent - a passive ability that differentiates them from other characters. [/i][/p][p]It’s one of the biggest changes in 1.0, [b]designed to make each run feel more distinct, and each Survivor more… themselves[/b]. For example, Diomedes - king of Argos, said to have founded ten cities before he died - gains bonus building speed with each completed structure and recovers some missing health.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/9c501d4303c22bcbe3e4fb175d0e41200dd1d618.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]🛠️ New Feature:[/b] Favors rework. [/h2][p][i]The Favour system has been overhauled![/i]
You’ll now experience [b]more meaningful build variety[/b] as each class feels more distinct - with new specialization paths and modifiers. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/6f02a866b185bced582398d166180d4d34c5898f.png"][/img][/p][h2]🛡️ [b]New Characters: [/b][/h2][h3][b]Achilles - the Kingslayer[/b][/h3][p][i]→ Fast striking speed, high mobility and dodge chance. An assassin who strikes from the shadows.[/i][/p][p]A silent killer forged in the fires of war.[/p][p]Achilles was once the shining hero of Greece - commander of the Myrmidons, unstoppable on the battlefield, and a demigod whose name echoed across the Aegean. But that man died in Troy. [b]What returned from the underworld is something else entirely.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/53014698c3fe491efe178bf34ac9b2ccbb2a829d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Now wearing the very armor in which he slew Agamemnon, Achilles no longer leads legions. He moves alone - fast, deadly, and unseen until it’s far too late.[/p][p]They call him… the Kingslayer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/3d02daf218dcef4b667e09230ab774a48b56dfc7.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Agamemnon - The Conqueror of Troy[/b][/h3][p]-> [i]High armor, heavy damage, low mobility. Commands the battlefield through brute force.[/i][/p][p]A heavy-armored warlord delivering devastating melee strikes.[/p][p][b]Agamemnon was never just a king - he was [i]the[/i] king.[/b] Ruler of Mycenae, supreme commander of the Greek forces during the Trojan War, and the man whose word brought fire and ruin to the walls of Troy. His brother Menelaus may have had the grudge, but it was Agamemnon who turned it into war.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/6ae70e8efcd7fa229b8436b2530031cb88154d18.gif"][/img][/p][p]Don’t expect elegance - his movement is slow, and his strategy relies on overwhelming force.[/p][p]Feared by his allies, hated by his enemies, and too proud for the gods themselves, Agamemnon led through dominance and blood. Now, ripped from the underworld and clad in iron heavier than his conscience, [b]he returns as a force of pure aggression.[/b] [/p][p]His thirst for power has only grown.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/ce2783b84f49a5d2266211eb788758bc86f1fbff.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Steropes, the Mighty Smasher[/b][/h3][p][i]→ Slow movement, high power, high armor. A walking tank who turns the battlefield into a demolition site.[/i][/p][p]A living relic of the old gods.[/p][p]Steropes is one of the Elder Cyclopes - the children of Gaia and Uranus, ancient blacksmiths who once forged the thunderbolts of Zeus. In the depths of Hephaestus’ forge, he shaped weapons that would shatter mountains. Now, he brings that same force to the battlefield.[/p][p][b]He doesn’t move fast. He doesn’t need to.[/b][/p][p]As a tank, he trades speed for overwhelming strength and heavy armor. Every strike lands like a forge hammer - slow to wind up, but absolutely crushing.[/p][p]He has one eye. Two fists. And zero patience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/b2dbff194b5d360f16de04cfcd26e4ed316766da.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Nezha - The Third Lotus Prince[/b][/h3][p][i]→ High mobility, high crit chance, lower shooting damage. A fast, unpredictable fighter who blends martial skill with magical trickery.[/i][/p][p]He’s not part of this pantheon - but he wasn’t going to let that stop him.[/p][p]Nezha is a legendary hero from Chinese mythology - [b]a rebellious celestial warrior born of a lotus flower, known for defying divine orders and rewriting his own fate.[/b] Armed with enchanted relics and impossible speed, he’s outpaced demons, dragons, and now even death itself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/c94458cc312d0f4807bd4079097c84c1a66c6afc.gif"][/img][/p][p]On the battlefield, Nezha is a blur. [b]He strikes with a fire-tipped spear, controls crowds with his Heavenly Sash, and moves like a storm on his signature Wind Fire Wheels.[/b] He may lack long-range firepower, but when it comes to close-quarters combat, few can match his precision and flair.[/p][p]Most heroes try to escape Tartarus.
Nezha ran straight in - not to join the fight, but to stir it up.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/160111f55f29ad6e3a80dfcb0976004e4f9c9597.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🌀 [b]New Power: Poseidon’s Fury[/b][/h3][p][i]Call upon the Lord of the Sea to unleash a mighty wave. [/i][/p][p]Poseidon sends a powerful surge forward, knocking back enemies in front of the Survivor. Great for creating breathing room - or wiping the battlefield clean.[/p][h2][b]🏛️ New Structures[/b][/h2][h3][b]Spin Blades[/b][/h3][p]This structure lashes out at nearby enemies with two rotating axes that extend and spin at regular intervals. [i]Deals damage and applies light knockback - perfect for crowd control.[/i][/p][h3][b]Statue of Medusa[/b][/h3][p][i]One glance and your foes freeze. You get paid.[/i]
Enemies that die to this cursed statue have a chance to turn to stone - and be converted directly into bonus Stone for your run. Build it smart, and let the Gorgon's gaze fund your construction empire.[/p][h2]⚔️ [b]New enemies and adjustments[/b][/h2][p][i]Prepare for very different nightmares[/i], as new Overlords \[Hades, Chimera], Midbosses \[Satyr, Centaur] and normal enemies join the battlefield. [/p][p]What’s more, cyclops and spider Midbosses gained some special attacks - now all the Midbosses in the game have them.[/p][h2]🏆 50 New Achievements Added[/h2][p][i]Plenty of new challenges to chase down.[/i][/p][p]To make your life easier, we also introduced achievement filtering in this update.[/p][h2]⚔️ [b]Balance changes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Lowered building and mining times in Short Mode to improve pacing and lower frustration.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]3 new improvements and tags were added: related to distance, melee, magic.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bosses in Hard Mode now deal less damage, making it more probable to survive… [/b]But never certain.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Hit Chance improvements were nerfed, as they were too powerful. The Trojan Horse structure received a minor nerf (now it grants 3% crit chance). Monument of Thunder was adjusted too.[/p][/*][*][p]Several characters were rebalanced and received changes to their passives. [/p][/*][*][p]Stone Golems now drop more Stone, befitting their name.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Graphic settings now save properly between sessions.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]“Kill inside circle” objectives now only depend on whether you’re actually inside the circle, instead of being based on enemies' placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manual Aim now works correctly in the Lava realm.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ranged enemies and their projectiles are now easier to spot in combat. Same for the Myrmidons.[/p][/*][*][p]Summary screen now includes damage caused by statuses.[/p][/*][*][p]You should no longer get stuck on power transformation screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where you could get stuck inside structures. There is no place to hide now.[/p][/*][/list][p]And much more![/p][h2]📜 The Road So Far[/h2][p]There’s always a bit of fear in releasing a game into the world. You never know what players will love, what they’ll demand with each update ([i]Endless Mode was a long time coming…[/i]), or what will quietly crash in the background while you sleep during the release ([i]broken saves on day one, anyone? We hope no one here remembers[/i]).[/p][p]But over the past months, you’ve helped shape Achilles: Survivor into something we’re truly proud of.[/p][p][b]During Early Access, we:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Got rid of 863 bugs,[/p][/*][*][p]Added Survivors, realms, powers, game modes, and more than a few spiders to the game,[/p][/*][*][p]Survived reading thousands of comments, reviews, and Discord messages (thank you!)[/p][/*][/list][p]What’s next?
Well, that’s a question for another day. [b]Today, we celebrate[/b] (and stay ready in case something breaks. Gotta love working in gamedev). [/p][p][b]Thank you for being here with us. [/b]We hope you enjoy 1.0 - and everything still to come.[/p][p]All the best from Toruń 💙[/p][p]~Dark Point Games Team[/p][p][/p][p][b]PS:[/b] If you’ve read this far… we’ve got a challenge for you.[/p][p]To celebrate version 1.0 and the arrival of Endless Mode, we’re running a [b]Discord competition[/b]. [/p][p]Your mission:
🎯 [b]Survive as long as you can on Endless Greece Coastline [/b]and post a screenshot in the right channel.[/p][p]Winners will earn a digital copy of one of our games, for any platform.[/p][p]▶ Full rules in the #survivor-news channel on Discord!
Good luck - and don't die too fast.[/p]

notes.title: Coming to Consoles & and How’s Achilles Doing? #1
notes.content:
Hello, Survivors!

We’ve got big news to share today - and it feels great to finally say it out loud:

[h2]🎮 Achilles: Survivor is coming to consoles![/h2]
You’ll be able to obliterate your enemies
[i](or be obliterated by them)[/i]
on [b]PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch[/b] in the second half of 2025.

Watch the trailer here: [previewyoutube=cG2gRn2by8I;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve come a long way since Early Access launch - and we couldn’t have done it without you. With the next update slowly approaching, we’re also preparing to welcome a whole new wave of players to the battlefield. But before that happens...

We’ve got more to share with you.

Starting today, we’re kicking off a small series of devlogs: part behind-the-scenes, part excuse to talk about mythology.

[h2]How’s Achilles Doing? #1 - Making Survivors More Special[/h2]
While we can’t share a date for the next update just yet (still in the Forge), we can say this: we are working on several topics at the moment, so you will be able to have endless fun while playing. 

And one thing we’re focused on right now is making every Survivor feel, well… more like themselves.

Because one of the comments we’ve seen the most is this: [quote] “Survivors feel too similar.” [/quote]And honestly? Yeah, that’s true. Outside their signature powers, most of them played a bit too much like Achilles in a different hat. We want to give each Survivor a more distinct identity and playstyle.

This brings us to Diomedes.

You might not know him as well as Paris or Prometheus, but Diomedes was no minor hero. [b]He ruled Argos with wisdom, led one of the largest Greek fleets to Troy, and after the war,  is said to have founded ten cities in Italy.[/b] Some even worshipped him as a god.

We wanted that legacy to come through in how he plays.
Right now, he already gets bonuses to structure durability, XP, and effectiveness - very on-brand for a seasoned strategist. But in the next update, we’re going a step further:
[quote]Every completed structure will grant Diomedes bonus building speed and heal him for a significant amount.[/quote] The more you build, the faster you become.[b] If you like structure-focused builds with a strong sustain loop, Diomedes might become your new favorite.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/60ca975b70576b4598c012fcedbb41d509ebe2df.gif[/img]
But what if you are a fan of a more dynamic playstyle?

[b]This is time for Alectryon to shine - literally. 
[/b]
In the myth, Alectryon was a young soldier who dozed off while standing guard for Ares - and accidentally let Helios catch the god in a compromising position. As punishment, Ares turned him into a rooster, cursed to wake the world each day with a cry.

In Achilles: Survivor, he’s still paying for that mistake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/867907151bb5419a83d08f4ae30bde0a070b8921.gif[/img]
Alectryon talent depends on him staying in motion. 

[b]The longer he moves, the more the air around him charges - until a burning sphere forms, circling him like the rising sun.[/b] When enemies get in touch with the sphere, it pushes them away, burning as hot as the sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/5250289877b1b2c6f7f3e46f2b1c1c7e315b6388.gif[/img]
[h2]Before we go…[/h2]
As always, everything you’ve read here is still in development - numbers may shift, abilities might change, and some surprises we haven’t even hinted at yet are still ahead.

What won’t change is how grateful we are for your support.

[b]Special thanks to everyone who’s been sharing feedback, balance ideas, and suggestions in the Steam forums and on our Discord after 0.6 update. [/b]You’ve helped shape this next phase of development more than you know!

Let us know how you're doing, and we hope you have an awesome Thursday. 💛

~Dark Point Games team

notes.title: Update 0.6: Into the Mountain Fortress
notes.content:
Hey Survivors!

Hope you’re feeling brave (and fireproof), because this one’s hot.
[b]Update 0.6 is live[/b] - and it’s our biggest yet, forged in the fire of your feedback (Mount Doom has nothing on it) and hundreds of hours of coding, testing and fixing.

[i]It’s going to be a long one; you’re going to need a jug full of coffee this time around [/i]☕

[h2]🌋 New Realm: Mountain Fortress
[/h2]Deep below the mortal world, beyond the reach of sea winds and sunlight, rises a fortress carved into the bones of a living volcano.

Its walls glow with molten veins. Its halls echo with the chants of Hades' sworn-cultists who traded their souls for power, and now worship death with every breath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/1ed82b8f6af0723556708e3d82d9f85254accdcb.png[/img]
In other words: [b]our third realm is here, and it’s full of lava. [/b]What to expect?
[list]
[*] Explore five handcrafted locations in the heart of a volcanic peak.
[*] Face new, tougher enemies & bosses.
[*] Don’t forget to enjoy the views!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/668c3155cabb4192dde43f63363377db0a16c982.gif[/img]
[h2]🕷️ New Survivor: Phalanx, the Venomous Spider
[/h2]Cursed and twisted by Athena for defying the gods, reborn with eight limbs and venomous fangs, he is a fast, lethal predator that weaves poison into every encounter.

Meet Phalanx, the Venomous Spider. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/d194db37280e49a5c690dc7b273b632cd25ce6cd.gif[/img]
He’s fast. He’s deadly. He’s got way too many legs.

Winner of our community vote, Phalanx, joins the Survivor roster with increased power range, critical chance, and movement speed, striking enemies from afar with volleys of poisonous thorns. Take a look at him in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/d4afd950bb70b412595f11e6da4db67afe6fa470.gif[/img][h2]🛠️ New Game Modes: Short Runs and Difficulty Levels
[/h2][h3]⏱️ 10-Minute Runs Are Here (Finally)[/h3]
This was, without a doubt, your #1 request.

Not everyone has 20 uninterrupted minutes. Some of you have families. Others have fatigue or health issues. And a few of you just really like intense, compact bloodbath.

[b]That’s why every realm now supports a short-run mode.[/b] Choose your location. Play for 10 minutes. Win, lose, repeat, it's up to you.

[h3]🎚️ Choose Your Difficulty[/h3]
You asked for more difficulty. And also less difficulty. So… we did both.
[list]
[*] [b]Easy[/b] – great for casual runs. 
[*] [b]Normal[/b] – Former default, balanced challenge.
[*] [b]Hard[/b] – Unlocks after your first clear. Proceed with caution.
[/list]Yes, you can switch anytime. No, we won’t judge. We’ve all been humbled by a flaming plant before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/80f6d0d2edb6e5c229664e8d2b0a066d59a23b5a.gif[/img][h2]⚔️ New Bosses & Midbosses[/h2]
New faces, same goal: send you back to Tartarus. Alongside new normal enemies, we’ve added four new bosses and midbosses - each designed to test your builds and reflexes. 

[h3]Boss: Talos, The Bronze Sentinel. 
[/h3]Each of his steps is an earthquake. A towering guardian forged by the gods, Talos, now stalks the Mountain Fortress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/890b1856e163303f02dfbf6a1e07608125849609.gif[/img][h3]Boss: Agamemnon, The Fallen King
[/h3]
Greece is his domain, and he is not happy to see you. Agamemnon brings tactical aggression to the battlefield. He punishes hesitation, and doesn’t go down easy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/d454f6cd995357c6663fea9e1665fe3f15e01658.gif[/img][h3]Midboss: Stone Golem 
[/h3]
Don’t let him fool you. One charge from this hunk of enchanted rock can flatten you.

[h3]Midboss: Fire Plant
[/h3]
If a flamethrower grew roots and hated you personally, this would be it. We’ve heard you loved plants, so we thought “how about a bigger one that shoots multiple projectiles at you?”.

[h2]🌀 New Challenge: Seal the Rift
[/h2]New location objective - [b]win by closing a massive, unstable Rift[/b] - a portal pumping out elite enemies non-stop.
[quote] Your goal: hold the line long enough to shut it.
Your tools: whatever you managed to scrounge together on this run.
Your odds? 

… Good luck! [/quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/2214cf6d62840ed1f67e8c27a2e2c1139b51208c.gif[/img][h2]💎 Increased Favour Levels
[/h2]If you clear Hard Mode, the gods will actually be impressed. They may even grant you Divine Crystals as a prize. [b]Using Divine Crystals, you can unlock higher Favour tiers[/b] and finally reach your full potential.

[h2]🪓 New Pick-Ups
[/h2]Want more stone?
Now you’ve got it.

Two shiny [b]new pickaxe tiers can now drop mid-run[/b], giving you bonus stone for building.

[h2]🏆 29 New Achievements
[/h2]That’s not a typo.

[h2]🧰 Major QoL Improvements:
[/h2]We made life (and death) just a little easier:
[list]
[*][b] New ‘unseen’ markers[/b] highlight powers, structures, and transformations you haven’t tried yet.
[*] [b]Restart from Summary screen:[/b] Quickly replay the same setup with one click.
[*] New Transformation icons: selected transformation icons are now more unique and better reflect their function.
[*] Disconnecting your controller now reliably pauses the game. 
[/list][h2]⚖️ Balance Adjustments:
[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Building damage now scales with location level[/b] so turrets & traps remain relevant in later stages.
[*] [b]Re-tuned Transformation and Improvement bonuses.[/b] Added/removed certain Transformations to keep your builds fresh.
[*] Titan’s Blade & Shield Throw gain the Cursed Gods Transformation that will give you more options to apply Curse to enemies, making it easier to complete related achievements.
[*] Armour values on Hector and Achilles re-balanced.
[*] 3 older achievements adjusted for smoother pacing.
[/list][h2]🐞 Over 50 Bugfixes:
[/h2][list][*]Max-level Favours now properly display their bonuses.
[*] Gold spent in Workshops counts toward statistics and Spend Gold objective.
[*] Fire Axes now reliably apply burn.
[*] Cursor visibility improved.
[*] 50 additional minor fixes including UI polish, language tweaks and various other topics.
[/list][h2]❤️ From Us to You
[/h2]So many of the changes in 0.6 were shaped by your feedback, votes, and comments. We’re a small team, still figuring things out, trying to make something special - and it means the world to have you along for the ride.

Thank you for being a part of our journey.

[b]If you feel like chatting, tell us in the comments:
[/b][list]
[*] What’s your favorite part of the update?
[*] What would you love to see next?
[/list] And hey - how are you doing on this beautiful (but cloudy) Wednesday?
~Dark Point Games team

notes.title: Happy Easter from Achilles!
notes.content:
Survivors!

Alectryon’s been busy in the fields, making sure everyone gets an egg.
We can’t promise they’ll hatch, but they might just explode.

[b]So from all of us at Dark Point Games: Happy Easter! [/b]

[h2]📜 The Road So Far[/h2]
[b]What happens to Achilles after his legend is told?[/b]

Launching [i]Achilles: Survivor[/i] was our take on the answer. He’s a hero - staying still never suited him.

What started as a small experiment quickly became something much more. We took a genre we love, added our favorite characters, and tried to build the kind of game we’d all enjoy playing.

When the first demo launched, we had one realm, two bosses, three Survivors, eleven powers… and a dream. [b]Fast forward 6 months, and more than 200 fixes and quality-of-life updates later:[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve just welcomed our ninth Survivor 
[*] Added multiple new activities, powers, structures, and favours
[*] Cured myrmidons our of procrastination, so they actually fight the enemies

[i]“Less time shall pass than from Chryses’ plea to Patroclus’ pyre…”[/i] whispers Pythia, her eyes clouded by smoke.

Across the battlefield, threads twist. Fangs flash in the dark. A shadow crawls where no man should tread - drawn to the cracks of a mountain that bleeds fire.

Violent and swift, it strikes harder than anything we’ve seen before.

And it’s getting closer.

[h2]💛 Every Step, Thanks to You[/h2]
To everyone who left a review, shared feedback, or fought through just one more wave: [b]thank you[/b].

If you’ve been enjoying Achilles: Survivor, let us know in the comments - or drop us a review!

We wouldn’t be in the same place without you - and the journey’s only just begun.

It’s a big one - so grab yourself a cup of tea, and let’s descend into the chaos together.


[h2]🏆 At Last: Steam Achievements are here![/h2]

You asked for it. We delivered.

Achievements are now fully integrated with Steam - and if you've already unlocked any, they'll automatically sync the next time you launch the game.

New ones are already waiting for you - can you catch them all?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/0febdd42fc8339e0522907adda99998bcd956ddf.png[/img]
[h2]🔥 1 New Character: Burn Them All[/h2]
[quote][i]The noble son of Iapetus outwitted him and stole the far-seen gleam of unwearying fire [/i]
— Hesiod, Theogony[/quote]
He stole fire from Olympus. Now he’s fighting for you.

Prometheus is a high-risk, high-reward Survivor with low health and rapid regeneration. He burns enemies with every hit using his unique Power: Fire Breath.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/4bc5249150d7cc83acc68abce837a2ebedf561c0.gif[/img]

[b]Fire Breath[/b]
Exhale pure destruction. Prometheus’s signature move scorches the battlefield (and your enemies) with a cone of flame.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/22b7ec0c070d920076d8dff8e5b21ea3e6f9ea5e.gif[/img]
[b]Souls of Tartarus[/b]
Summon the damned. Cursed spirits rise from the underworld, latching onto enemies and tearing them apart with dark energy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/c8f73ecd7484e66fb15125e9493d492f648ed198.gif[/img]

[h2]🏛️ 3 New Structures: Wrath, Engineered[/h2]
[b]Monument of Thunder[/b]
A divine turret that channels Zeus himself. It strikes enemies [i]near you[/i], no matter where it’s built.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/f69f4695e1c4bdd7c8b0697ec89d492c2cdfeb51.gif[/img]
[b]Dart Thrower[/b]
A circle of death. This construct fires high-speed darts in all directions, piercing through enemies like butter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/24671635b34f4a722d52ca5de6e27f3452c0adf9.gif[/img]
[b]Spike Trap[/b]
Stop enemies dead in their tracks. Lay brutal spike traps - enemies who step on it get a face full of Olympus-grade steel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/b2cf305d7cf3f7ae043a1f329ff74e56429e6108.gif[/img]

[h2]💰 4 New Favours: Choose Your Divine Blessing[/h2]
Need a stronger start? Four new Favours have been added to expand your options:
[list] [*][b]Patience Pays Off[/b] - Start with higher Status Strength
[*][b]Plutus’ Generosity[/b] - Begin each run with extra gold
[*][b]Gaia’s Blessing[/b] - Gain bonus stone at the start
[*][b]Passionate Miner[/b] - Increases mining speed and yields more stone per cycle
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ 5 Major Balance & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement progress is now displayed in-game, making it easy to track how much you are missing.
[*] The “How to Play” tab now shows you stats for all powers.
[*] Apollo’s Light (Pythia’s power) has been improved: orbs orbit closer to you for better control.
[*] Selected transformation icons are now more unique and better reflect their function.
[*] Structures now visibly react to damage.
[/list]
[h2]🛠️ 6 Various Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moirai Thread power got a buff (and a new transformation)
[*] Striking Speed got a much needed nerf (yes, you were overpowered - we saw you).
[*] Achievement grind reduced - The Power of Magic and I Just Want to Fight now unlock with fewer runs.
[*] Visual effects now display correctly on all eight-legged abominations.
[*] Your thrown shield will now reliably return to you. As it should.
[*] Minor performance improvements and optimizations.
[/list]
[h2]🏆 7 New Achievements: Good luck hunting![/h2]
Seven new achievements have also been added with this update: A builder, Bones bones bones, Pyromaniac, Experienced Marksman, It’s a Trap, Unforgivable Curse, Architect.
[h2]🌍 Now in Korean and Japanese[/h2]
To all our new Survivors from Korea and Japan —
[b]Welcome to the battlefield.[/b]

We’re proud to bring full language support in this update. Let us know what you think and how we can make it even better.

[h2]…Still here with us, Survivor? 
[/h2]
Your dedication deserves a reward.

We’re running a [b]community vote for the next Survivor[/b] on our Discord server. Want to shape the future of the game? Now's your chance.


[h2]💛 Few Words from Our Team[/h2]
Every spark of this update came from you.

From bug reports to bold ideas, your feedback helps us shape the world of Achilles: Survivor - one update at a time.

Our games come from a deep love for ancient myths and joy of gaming. We are so happy to share it with you. Seeing this community grow with us has been humbling, motivating, and honestly? Kind of epic.

Thank you for being here.

[b]What’s your favorite part of this update? Let us know in the comments below![/b]
See you on the battlefield,
(or our Discord server).

~Dark Point Games team

notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

First of all, a huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone playing "[b]Achilles: Survivor[/b]" in Early Access! Your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2922410/discussions/0/]Steam forums[/url] and [url=http://discord.gg/achilleslegendsuntold]Discord[/url] has been invaluable, and we truly appreciate your support and engagement.

One of our top priorities has been improving the [b]game's performance[/b]. With this hotfix, we’ve implemented a solution that enhances stability and improves overall smoothness. This is just the beginning—performance optimization [b]will continue[/b] as we refine the game further. 

Shortly after launch, we noticed that some players with [b]saves from the demo[/b] were unable to start the game. Reacting quickly was a [b]top priority[/b] for us, and we managed to release a fix within just [b]two hours[/b] after launch to resolve the issue.

This update is a rework of [b]memory management for enemies[/b]. The previous system proved to be [b]inefficient[/b] in later stages of the game, leading to performance drops. With this new approach, enemies are now handled more efficiently in memory, reducing unnecessary strain on the system and improving overall gameplay smoothness.

[h1]What’s included in this hotfix:[/h1]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]

We’re working tirelessly to [b]fine-tune[/b] the gameplay and polish every detail. This means adjusting powers and their transformations, as well as [b]cleaning up[/b] the menus to ensure everything is clear and intuitive. Today, we’ll give you an overview of how the game works and what you can expect when we officially move into [b]Early Access in just one week![/b]

[previewyoutube=z2Glchmijoc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Survivors[/b][/h1]
You’ll start the game with only [i]Achilles[/i] unlocked, and as you play, you’ll complete specific [b]achievements[/b] to unlock more characters. During [b]Early Access[/b], you’ll have a roster of [b]11 unique characters[/b] (with plans to expand this in the future), each featuring their own starting power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/c8985d29bf103b487dc2a88c6338cdd482a47f53.png[/img]

[h1][b]Powers[/b][/h1]
Powers can be improved infinitely with level-ups, but at levels 5, 10, and 15, a power can be transformed to better suit your current build. Visual cues will indicate when a power is eligible for transformation. To unlock these, you’ll need to construct a Forge, a special structure that can be built in designated areas on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/eaad7863c0390b84d0e17bfa1edd0283ddefc374.png[/img]

[h1][b]Transformations[/b][/h1] Transformations offer a variety of options to truly customize your build. Each power can have up to 3 transformations, giving you the tools to overcome the game’s challenges.

Transformations can provide bonuses such as increased damage or reduced cooldowns. Sometimes they’ll be straightforward upgrades, while other times you may need to sacrifice one stat to significantly boost another.

They also introduce special effects, like adding status damage, altering projectile behavior, or adding knockback. Experiment with these to [b]create an unstoppable build[/b] as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/4280fa41745aaff6a32bba2d714d2f12ef57e361.png[/img]

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
Each time you level up, you’ll choose from one of [b]four Improvements[/b] to enhance your run. If none of the options suit your build, you can spend gold to [b]reroll[/b] for new choices—so it’s a good idea to keep some gold on hand!

Improvements can affect Powers, Structures, and Player stats in different ways, ensuring that every run feels fresh and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/bfd3b1852e4e953470fadaa1879cc0168c34dcf7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Minimap[/b][/h1]
The minimap is your best friend! It shows areas where you can build Structures, marks those you’ve already built, and highlights resource locations. You’ll also see where you can construct mines and find treasures scattered throughout the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/cc705cb7179d90aa7a29ebda4108e6adb004cc03.png[/img]

[h1][b]Structures[/b][/h1]
From fiery turrets that wreak havoc to support [b]Structures[/b] that aid you in battle, Structures are a key feature of "[b]Achilles: Survivor[/b]". They don’t just deal damage or heal—you’ll also gain passive bonuses to further empower your Survivor.

Structures can help you outmaneuver tougher enemies, acting as terrain that lets you keep your distance while striking safely. They can also be upgraded by selecting specific Improvements during gameplay and boosting them further through Favors between battles.

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello [b]Survivors[/b],

We’re back with another development update for [b]Achilles: Survivor[/b]! 

Our team has been hard at work implementing changes and improvements to the game. These adjustments have been made in collaboration with our QA department, inspired by our own ideas, but most importantly, shaped by the [b]valuable feedback[/b] we received from players who tested the game during the [b]demo period[/b]. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Building Passive Description[/b]

We’ve updated the descriptions of buildings to explicitly state that they function regardless of the player’s location. This UX improvement aims to ensure that [b]all information[/b] presented to the player is [b]100% clear[/b] and leaves no room for confusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/57833424927d9387b9bab2537f156f7dc8e7dfb6.png[/img]

[b]Improved Status Effects[/b]

We’re refining [b]all status effects[/b] like Burn, Poison, and Curse to ensure they stack properly and provide clear visual feedback when they are active. This should enhance both strategy and gameplay immersion.

[b]Graphic Settings Adjustments[/b]

Players will now have the ability to [b]enable[/b] or [b]disable[/b] various graphical technologies. This feature allows players to tailor the visual aspects of the game to [b]their preferences[/b] and hardware capabilities, leading to a more stable and personalized experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/5ee70e146e05d097135ec052dc0c90bce6843bd1.png[/img]

[b]Ranged Enemies[/b]

We’ve introduced r[b]anged enemies[/b] to the game, adding a new layer of challenge and strategic depth. Their inclusion should make the gameplay more dynamic and engaging.

[b]Revamped Powers selection[/b]

We’ve added the reroll system for picking up powers after a level up. This change allows players to craft builds that suit their playstyle and ensures that power selection isn’t just a matter of picking one out of four random options but a [b]meaningful[/b] decision that [b]impacts[/b] gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/7dcce6175c1bf3c8a49ed4b7241857d53f3edfb2.png[/img]

We’re committed to delivering the best possible experience, and your feedback continues to be the foundation of our development efforts. Keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us – together, we’ll make [b]Achilles: Survivor[/b] even better!

Thank you for your support,

- Dark Point Games team

notes.title: Demo Feedback Answered
notes.content:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]

We've been closely following your feedback, and we want to take a moment to share our thoughts and plans. [b]Your insights are incredibly valuable in helping us improve the game, [/b]and we're excited to address some of the most common issues you've raised.

We've divided the feedback into three main categories:
[list]
[*] Areas We Are Actively Working To Improve
[*] Planned Improvements Based on Feedback
[*] Features and Mechanics That Are Intended as Is
[/list]

[b]So, LET'S ROLL[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195884/6e590b4afef23bed9b004d9ad4b8d461da88b4fb.gif[/img]

[h1]Areas We Are Actively Working To Improve[/h1]

[b]Character Movement and Responsiveness[/b]

We've noted your concerns about slow or "floaty" character movement and inconsistent attack speed for certain characters. This is definitely an area we’re working on to make the gameplay feel more responsive and enjoyable.

[b]Game Mechanics and Balance[/b]

Balancing the improvements, powers, and progression system is a top priority. We recognize the need for smoother progression and more balanced skills so that players can build powerful and exciting character builds.

[b]Construction and Building System[/b]

We’re improving clarity around the construction system. Issues like getting stuck in the construction menu, loot drops inside buildings, and missing functionality in structures are all being addressed.

[b]User Interface and Upgrade Feedback[/b]

We understand that sometimes it’s unclear how upgrades impact gameplay. We’re enhancing tooltips and status effects to improve readability and understanding of the game across all aspects. This will make it easier to see what each upgrade does and how it affects your abilities.

[b]Tutorial and New Player Experience[/b]

Many of you have mentioned a lack of guidance on gameplay basics. We’re planning to introduce a tutorial and more accessible information on powers, improvements, and transformations to help new players get started.

[b]Random Map Generation[/b]

The map layouts are randomly generated to keep each run fresh, adding an extra layer of challenge and replayability to the experience. Additionally, some maps will have fixed layouts, providing a more structured gameplay experience.

[h1]Planned Improvements Based on Feedback[/h1]

[b]UI Adjustments[/b]

Enhancing the user interface is one of our top priorities. We're focusing on making every piece of information in Achilles: Survivor easily accessible and clear. Our goal is to ensure that players have a complete understanding of how various elements influence the gameplay. This will allow you to build your character more effectively and maintain better control over the flow of the game. Expect updates to the UI that will make the experience both clearer and more functional, so you can focus on crafting the perfect strategy!

[b]Forge and Mine Clarity[/b]

The Forge and Mine features will be more intuitive, and their impact on gameplay will be more transparent to players.

[b]Powers Customization and Rerolling[/b]

We’ve heard your feedback on the need for more control over powers selection, and we’re planning to add a reroll option. This will give you more flexibility in customizing your builds.

[h1]Features and Mechanics That Are Intended as Is[/h1]

[b]Lack of Manual Aiming[/b]

While we appreciate the suggestions for manual aiming, this was a deliberate design choice to keep controls accessible and straightforward. We believe that auto-targeting keeps the gameplay fast-paced and aligns with the overall game design.

[h1]Positive Feedback and Closing Thoughts[/h1]
Thank you for the positive comments on our graphics, building system, and core gameplay mechanics! We’re thrilled that many of you are enjoying these aspects, and we’ll continue working to make your experience even better. Your feedback drives us to create a game that resonates with players and is as enjoyable as possible.

[b]Thank you for your continued support, and keep the feedback coming![/b]

[b]Your Dark Point Games Team [/b]
